items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... 'Now this is your cousin Suzie, on your Aunt Mary's side...' [INTERVIEWEE] Well, that's the way it went down.

ctx.x: And so I have one side of the family as my grandfather's side, and the other side of the family is my grandmother's side. So my cousin Harold is on my grandfather's side, and my cousin Preston is on my grandmother's side, so that's the Exuma side of the family -- and then there's the Nassau side of the family. They're all messed up!

A lot of soul brothers have that kind of thing. I can remember hearing my grandmother say things like that -- "Now this is your cousin Suzie, on your Aunt Mary's side, and this is your cousin Joe on ..." and you really get all mixed up there.

Well, that's the way it went down. Because, you know, I don't know anything about my great grandfather on my grandmother's side, but my great grandfather on my father's side was an ex-slave from South Carolina, and they stole a boat, and that's how they got to Nassau.
